pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with sharp edge gradients and dark pigmentation. Patches on the upper flank and neck exhibit larger spatial area, while patches on the lower flank and hindquarters transition to smaller, more fragmented geometries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space separating the dark patches. The network features frequent three-way and four-way junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively thin and consistent throughout the mid-flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A visible jagged 1D silhouette along the dorsal edge of the neck, characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the background.
